request: How large is the immigration court backlog and how has it changed over time?

reply.reply:
**The immigration court backlog reached 3,558,995 pending cases at the end of FY2024; it first exceeded 1 million in FY2019 and has continued to grow.**

- At the end of FY2024, EOIR had 3,558,995 pending immigration court cases. (IN12492, PDF p. 4)
- The backlog exceeded 1 million in FY2019 and reached 1,405,386 cases at the end of FY2021, according to EOIR. (R47077, PDF p. 21)
- In FY2024, judges completed a record 701,749 cases while EOIR received an average 148,663 new cases per month. (IN12492, PDF p. 4)
reply.reasoning: CRS reports 3,558,995 pending cases at the end of FY2024. An earlier CRS report places the backlog above 1 million in FY2019 and at about 1.4 million at FY2021 end, documenting substantial growth over time.
